name: @encore/playwright
description: Encore Playwright test suite — self-contained client deliverable

scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.setup:browsers: npx playwright install chromium firefox webkit
scripts.clean: rimraf reports/allure-results reports/allure-report reports/diagnostics reports/walkthrough reports/html-report reports/test-results reports/test-results.json reports/failure-summary.json reports/junit-results.xml logs/test-execution.log
scripts.build:framework: node -e "console.error('ERROR: vendored framework is pre-built; do not run from deliverable. To rebuild, run from source repo: npm run vendor:build -- --client=encore'); process.exit(1)"
